# reco_custom_compliance_framework (Resource)

Manages a Reco custom compliance framework and its controls. Each control maps to one or more posture checks. Built-in frameworks cannot be managed with this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "reco_custom_compliance_framework" "internal_controls" {
  title       = "Internal Security Controls"
  description = "Framework for compliance as defined in corporate guidelines spec 7984."
  version     = "1.0"
  is_active   = true

  controls = [
    {
      control_id = "ACC"
      title      = "Access control"
    },
    {
      control_id         = "ACC-1"
      title              = "MFA is enforced for all users"
      parent_control_id  = "ACC"
      related_policy_ids = ["11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"] # posture check IDs
    },
    {
      control_id        = "ACC-2"
      title             = "Quarterly access review"
      description       = "Reviewed manually by the security team."
      parent_control_id = "ACC"
      manual            = true
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) Framework display name.

### Optional

- `controls` (Attributes List) Controls of the framework. Every update replaces the full control list, so omitting this attribute removes all existing controls. The Reco API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected and it is empty after import. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--controls))
- `description` (String) Longer description shown in the Reco UI.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the framework is active. The Reco API applies this value only when the framework is created, so changing it forces the framework to be destroyed and recreated. When omitted, the framework is created inactive and the value reported by Reco is tracked.
- `type` (String) Free-text framework type.
- `version` (String) Framework version string.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the framework was created (read-only).
- `id` (String) Framework ID (set after create).
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the framework was last updated (read-only).

<a id="nestedatt--controls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `controls`

Required:

- `control_id` (String) Control identifier within the framework.
- `title` (String) Control display name.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Control description.
- `manual` (Boolean) Whether the control is evaluated manually.
- `parent_control_id` (String) The control_id of the parent control, when this control is nested.
- `related_policy_ids` (List of String) IDs (UUIDs) of the posture checks mapped to this control.
- `skipped` (Boolean) Whether the control is skipped.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = reco_custom_compliance_framework.internal_controls
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```
